text:
System Design & AI Architecture Kit v1.6.0

Cmd/Ctrl + /  then type a name  ->  Enter
   inserts the item (no dragging)
Library search: every name starts "sd:"
   "sd:" = whole kit, "sd:data/" = one section,
   or just "kafka", "redis", "agent"...

Sections (sd:...): note client edge svc data
 cache msg ai agent rag llmops ops ext
 zone link ui frame screen pattern agentic tpl

Double-click a box to rename it.
